statement: Owner-scope path classification treats solve/epics/*.md planning memos as documentation, not workflow tooling: classifyPath checks the docs rule for the solve/epics prefix before the broad solve/ workflow prefix, so a runtime process Quest that cites an epic in links.planDoc or links.specRef is classified runtime (matching its runtime guard files) rather than inheriting workflow scope and being refused by the changeRef gate. Guards the gold-plating epic poisoning three runtime process Quests.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
